verdict.rationale: Granola Chat lets users interact via natural-language queries to recall meeting details, spot patterns, and trigger actions like drafting/sending a follow-up email, drafting a Slack message, or creating a calendar event—clear NL-command operation within the product. missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration of chat-driven command execution, and detail on reliability/limits of the NL command surface beyond first-party docs.
